data.narrative:
Unseenlabs is a Series C-stage Space & Aerospace company that has raised €112.5M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a comparable universe of 7 private peers in the same sector and stage, including Sierra Space ($8.0B Series C), Impulse Space ($4.3B Series D), and Apex Space ($2.3B Series D), alongside 5 public Space & Aerospace comps (RKLB, PL, LUNR, ASTS, SATL).

Two valuation methods are applicable. The stage-progression method applies a 1.7x step-up multiplier typical of Series C advancement to the $112.5M capital raised, yielding $191M. The peer-median approach anchors to the $2.0B median valuation across the 7-company same-sector peer set, which spans $1.15B to $8.0B. Public-comp anchoring is not applicable because Unseenlabs' revenue is not disclosed. The public sector median P/S of 24.4x cannot be applied without revenue data.

The triangulated analysis across both applicable methods supports a valuation range of $163M (low) to $2.3B (high), with a median of $1.1B. This wide range reflects material uncertainty: the stage-progression method implies upside from the capital base, while peer comparables—driven substantially by high-stage Space & Aerospace multiples—anchor the median. Key uncertainties include the target's revenue trajectory, which would refine public-comp applicability, and whether peers' valuations reflect comparable revenue scale and market positioning.
